result.instructions: Tools for Follow Up Boss, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Follow Up Boss data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run fub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fub_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fub_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. fub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fub_get_identity
tools.title: Get identity
tools.description: Who the credential belongs to: the account (id, domain, owner) and the authenticated user. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. FUB: GET /v1/identity.

tools.name: fub_search_people
tools.title: Search people (contacts/leads)
tools.description: Search contacts and leads. Criteria combine with AND. Name filters are partial matches. Newest first by default. People in the Trash stage are excluded unless includeTrash is true. Not every field is returned by default — pass `fields` (e.g. "allFields" or a comma list) for more. FUB: GET /v1/people.

assignedTo.description: Full name of the assigned agent.

smartListId.description: Only people matching this Smart List.

includeTrash.description: Include people in the Trash stage.

sort.description: Sort field, e.g. "created", "lastActivity", "name"; prefix "-" for descending.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

next.description: Cursor from the previous page's _metadata.next. Recommended over offset.

tools.name: fub_get_person
tools.title: Get one person
tools.description: Fetch one contact by id. Pass fields="allFields" to include custom fields and everything else. FUB: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_check_duplicate_person
tools.title: Check whether a person exists
tools.description: Check if a contact with this email or phone already exists anywhere in the account (even ones this user cannot see) and who it is assigned to. Use before adding a lead. FUB: GET /v1/people/checkDuplicate.

tools.name: fub_list_events
tools.title: List lead events
tools.description: Lead activity: registrations, inquiries, viewed/saved properties, website visits, etc. Filter by person or type. Some events are only visible in the FUB app. FUB: GET /v1/events.

type.description: Comma-separated event types, e.g. "Registration,Property Inquiry". One of: Registration, Inquiry, Seller Inquiry, Property Inquiry, General Inquiry, Viewed Property, Saved Property, Visited Website, Incoming Call, Unsubscribed, Property Search, Saved Property Search, Visited Open House, Viewed Page.

hasProperty.description: Only events with (or without) a property attached.

propertyAddress.description: Partial match on the property address.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

next.description: Cursor from the previous page's _metadata.next. Recommended over offset.

tools.name: fub_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: Logged phone calls with outcome, direction and duration. Filter by person or number. FUB: GET /v1/calls.

phone.description: Calls to or from this person's number.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_text_messages
tools.title: List text messages
tools.description: Text messages for a person or a phone number (message bodies may be hidden by FUB for privacy). FUB: GET /v1/textMessages.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Tasks (follow-ups, calls, showings…). Filter by person, assignee, type, completion, or due window (due="today"|"overdue"|"upcoming"). FUB: GET /v1/tasks.

assignedUserId.description: Only tasks assigned to this user id.

assignedTo.description: Only tasks assigned to this user (full name).

type.description: Comma-separated types. One of: Follow Up, Call, Text, Email, Appointment, Showing, Closing, Open House, Thank You.

dueStart.description: Due at or after this time.

dueEnd.description: Due at or before this time.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: Calendar appointments with invitees, type and outcome. Filter by person, user, or a start+end window (both required together). FUB: GET /v1/appointments.

personId.description: Person id, or a comma-separated list of ids.

start.description: Window start (ISO-8601). Must be combined with end.

end.description: Window end (ISO-8601). Must be combined with start.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: Deals (transactions) with stage, price, people, agents and commission. Filter by pipeline, user, person or status. The response metadata includes totalByStageId. FUB: GET /v1/deals.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: Deal pipelines with their stages (the stage ids that fub_create_deal / fub_update_deal take). FUB: GET /v1/pipelines.

tools.name: fub_list_stages
tools.title: List contact stages
tools.description: Contact lifecycle stages (Lead, Nurture, Past Client, Trash…) with people counts — the names fub_search_people and fub_update_person take as "stage". FUB: GET /v1/stages.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_users
tools.title: List users (agents)
tools.description: Users in the account (agents, brokers, lenders) — the ids to assign people, tasks and deals to. FUB: GET /v1/users.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The account's contact custom fields: label, API name (customXxx), type and dropdown choices. Use the name as a key in customFields. FUB: GET /v1/customFields.

label.description: Find a custom field by label.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

tools.name: fub_send_lead_event
tools.title: Send in a lead / lead event
tools.description: Add a new lead or record activity on an existing one — FUB's documented way to create leads. FUB de-duplicates by email/phone (or use person.id to target a contact), routes the lead per Lead Flow, notifies the agent and runs action plans for Registration / Inquiry types. A 204 means the lead flow for this source is archived and the event was ignored. FUB: POST /v1/events.

type.description: Event type. "Inquiry" becomes Property or General Inquiry automatically.

source.description: Lead source name, e.g. "MyWebsite.com". Used for Lead Flow routing.

system.description: Name of the system sending the lead.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 time it happened. Events older than a day are historical and do not trigger workflows.

id.description: Existing person id to attach this event to.

customFields.description: Account custom fields, keyed by their API name (e.g. {"customBirthday": "1990-02-16"}). See the `name` column of fub_list_custom_fields. null clears a value.

property.description: The property the event is about.

annotations.title: Send in a lead / lead event

tools.name: fub_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: Update a contact's fields. CAUTION: `tags` REPLACES all tags unless mergeTags is true; `phones` and `emails` REPLACE the full list (send existing ones too). Setting contacted=true pauses action plans. source/sourceUrl cannot be changed after creation. FUB: PUT /v1/people/{id}.

mergeTags.description: Merge `tags` into the existing tags instead of replacing them.

customFields.description: Account custom fields, keyed by their API name (e.g. {"customBirthday": "1990-02-16"}). See the `name` column of fub_list_custom_fields. null clears a value.

tools.name: fub_add_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline. FUB: POST /v1/notes.

isHtml.description: Render HTML tags in the body.

tools.name: fub_log_call
tools.title: Log a call
tools.description: Record a phone call made or received outside FUB, with its outcome. Does not place a call. FUB: POST /v1/calls.

isIncoming.description: true for an incoming call, false for outgoing.

userId.description: User who took the call (admins only).

tools.name: fub_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task on a contact, assigned to a user (assignedUserId or assignedTo is required). FUB: POST /v1/tasks.

assignedUserId.description: User id to assign (or give assignedTo).

assignedTo.description: Full name of the user to assign (or give assignedUserId).

remindSecondsBefore.description: Reminder lead time; only for tasks with a due time.

tools.name: fub_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Update a task — mark it complete, rename, retype or reassign it. FUB: PUT /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fub_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Create a deal in a pipeline stage (stage ids from fub_list_pipelines). Include userIds — a deal with no users is invisible to agents. FUB: POST /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_update_deal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Update a deal — move it to another stage, change price, dates, people or agents. peopleIds/userIds replace the full list. FUB: PUT /v1/deals/{id}.
